name: blueprint
description: 8 specialized AI agents that transform your app idea into a complete, annotated build brief — brand identity, API contracts, database schema, TDD strategy, UI spec, and a one-shot master prompt. Supports Gemini, OpenAI, Groq, and Azure OpenAI.

enumDescriptions: Azure OpenAI — your deployed Azure OpenAI resource
LiteLLM — Connect to any model via a LiteLLM proxy
blueprint.provider.markdownDescription:
The LLM provider to use for all Blueprint agents.

Configure credential fields for the chosen provider below.

blueprint.gemini.apiKey.markdownDescription:
**Gemini API Key** — get yours at [aistudio.google.com](https://aistudio.google.com/).

_Required when `blueprint.provider` is `gemini`._

blueprint.gemini.model.markdownDescription:
Gemini model to use.

- `gemini-3.1-flash` — **April 2026 Latest**: Ultra-fast, KV-caching optimized
- `gemini-3.1-pro` — **Flagship**: Deepest understanding & reasoning
- `gemini-3-deep-think` — Specialized for extremely complex logic
- `gemini-1.5-pro` — High quality legacy stable

_If set to `other`, the value from `blueprint.gemini.customModel` will be used._

blueprint.gemini.customModel.markdownDescription: **Custom Gemini Model ID** — specify any model ID (e.g., `gemini-experimental`). _Only used if `blueprint.gemini.model` is set to `other`._

blueprint.openai.apiKey.markdownDescription:
**OpenAI API Key** — get yours at [platform.openai.com](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys).

_Required when `blueprint.provider` is `openai`._

blueprint.openai.model.markdownDescription:
OpenAI model to use.

- `gpt-5.4` — **April 2026 Flagship**: Best quality
- `o4-mini` — Fastest reasoning-focused model
- `gpt-4o` — High quality legcy

_If set to `other`, the value from `blueprint.openai.customModel` will be used._

blueprint.openai.customModel.markdownDescription: **Custom OpenAI Model Name** — specify any model name (e.g., `gpt-3.5-turbo-16k`). _Only used if `blueprint.openai.model` is set to `other`._

blueprint.openai.baseUrl.markdownDescription: **OpenAI Base URL** — override for custom proxies or OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Leave as default for standard OpenAI usage.

blueprint.groq.apiKey.markdownDescription:
**Groq API Key** — get yours at [console.groq.com](https://console.groq.com/).

_Required when `blueprint.provider` is `groq`._

blueprint.groq.model.markdownDescription:
Groq model to use.

- `llama-3.3-70b-versatile` — Balanced speed/quality
- `qwen-2.5-coder-32b` — **Top Tier Coding**: Recommended for Blueprint
- `deepseek-v3` — High efficiency reasoning
- `mistral-saba-24b` — Ultra-fast inference

_If set to `other`, the value from `blueprint.groq.customModel` will be used._

blueprint.groq.customModel.markdownDescription: **Custom Groq Model Name** — specify any model name (e.g., `llama3-8b-8192`). _Only used if `blueprint.groq.model` is set to `other`._

blueprint.azure.apiKey.markdownDescription:
**Azure OpenAI API Key** — found in your Azure Portal under your OpenAI resource → Keys and Endpoint.

_Required when `blueprint.provider` is `azure-openai`._

blueprint.azure.endpoint.markdownDescription:
**Azure OpenAI Endpoint** — e.g. `https://my-resource.openai.azure.com`

Found in Azure Portal → your OpenAI resource → Endpoint.

blueprint.azure.deploymentName.markdownDescription: **Azure Deployment Name** — the name you gave your model deployment in Azure AI Studio (e.g. `gpt-4o-deployment`).

blueprint.azure.apiVersion.markdownDescription:
**Azure OpenAI API Version** — use the latest preview version for best features.

_If set to `other`, the value from `blueprint.azure.customApiVersion` will be used._

blueprint.azure.customApiVersion.markdownDescription: **Custom Azure API Version** — specify any API version string (e.g., `2024-10-01-preview`). _Only used if `blueprint.azure.apiVersion` is set to `other`._

blueprint.litellm.apiKey.markdownDescription:
**LiteLLM API Key** — Optional if your proxy doesn't require one.

_Used when `blueprint.provider` is `litellm`._

blueprint.litellm.model.markdownDescription: **LiteLLM Model ID** — The name of the model as configured in your LiteLLM proxy.

blueprint.litellm.baseUrl.markdownDescription: **LiteLLM Base URL** — The URL of your running LiteLLM proxy (usually http://localhost:4000/v1).
